title: Kaliyan Shahzadian Aaya Shaam Bazaar Baaj Ridawa Te
body:
Enj Musal Muna Lut Paaye, Na Puthar Bache Na Bhai  (x2) Turpaya Aah Naal Beemar Baaj Ridawa Te.
<<DIVIDER>>
Ghazi Di Saang Nu, Laila Nay Vekh Kay, Kooka Si Mariya.
Jidan Lokan Sang Barsaaen, Ay Keh Kay Bhagi Ayein.
Hoyan Zakhmi Pardaydaar Baaj Ridawan Tay.
<<DIVIDER>>
Diyan Ali Diya Hath Paakey Rasiyan Pandkar Ke Door Daa
Aayan Wich Bazaar Dey Chalke Kaey Zulm Ummat De Jalke
Aah Kariyan Wich Darbar Baaj Ridawa Te.
<<DIVIDER>>
Veeran De Laash Te Behna Kalogaya Eh Kehke Ro Paya
Asan Veeran Baou Majbooran Lutya Putya Mastooran
Hoyan Shaam Wale Tayaar Baaj Ridawa Te.
<<DIVIDER>>
Loghon Haya Karo Na Berida Karo Aale Rasool Nu
Dithay Bhurkeh Aanesayan Jadun Vekhiya Zahra Jaiyan
Hai Majme De Vichkaar Baaj Ridawa Te.
<<DIVIDER>>
Arshan Tu Anke Jinna De Nooriyan Jhoole Jhoolayine
Aaj Unt Ne Baaj Palane Kulsoom Zainab Rab Jaane
Kinj Hogaya Asawar Baaj Ridawa Te.
<<DIVIDER>>
Akhtar Batool Da Jadoon Ghar Si Jhalriya Zainab Nay Akhiyan
Sajaad Dasa Ki Kariye Ehs Aag Vich Sar Ke Marye
Yaan Aaiye Khaymayon Baar Baaj Ridawaan Day.
